page.overview:
What is Duilwen?

Duilwen was one of the seven rivers of Ossiriand in Beleriand during the First Age.thumb|240x240px|leftThe Duilwen began from the Blue Mountains and was one of the six tributaries of the great river Gelion. It lay between the two other rivers of Ossiriand: Brilthor and Adurant. According to Karen Wynn Fonstad's The Atlas of Middle-earth, it was nearly one-hundred and fifty miles in length.

Duilwen meant 'Fresh river' in Sindarin.
